name: fpay-monorepo
_comment_workspaces: apps/mobile is deliberately excluded — its deps cost ~169MB and no mobile work is planned. Its source is untouched; add 'apps/mobile' back here and run yarn install to resume (then `npx expo prebuild -p android` to regenerate the native project).

scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; yarn dev:backend & yarn workspace @fpay/web dev & yarn workspace @fpay/admin dev & yarn workspace @fpay/landing dev & wait
scripts.dev:web: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; yarn dev:backend & yarn workspace @fpay/web dev & wait
scripts.dev:admin: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; yarn dev:backend & yarn workspace @fpay/admin dev & wait
scripts.dev:landing: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; yarn dev:backend & yarn workspace @fpay/landing dev & wait
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @fpay/shared tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @fpay/backend tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @fpay/web tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @fpay/admin tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @fpay/landing tsc --noEmit
scripts._comment_tools: Everything below is a one-line delegation so repo-level tools are typed the short way: `yarn db:seed`, not `yarn workspace @fpay/backend db:seed`. The whole db:* family is aliased rather than only the documented ones — `yarn db:migrate` working while `yarn db:new` does not is a worse trap than neither existing. Deliberately NOT aliased: per-app `build` / `start`, because the Vercel configs (root vercel.json for web, apps/{admin,landing}/vercel.json) and .githooks/pre-push run those exact strings, and a second way to say them is a second thing to drift.
scripts._comment_checks: The self-checks: every one is plain node with no DB and no network, so check:all runs anywhere in about a second. It is `check:all` and not `check` because `yarn check` is a Yarn 1 BUILTIN (lockfile verifier) and builtins resolve ahead of scripts — a script named `check` would be silently shadowed.
scripts.check:all: yarn check:env && yarn check:money && yarn check:paytarget && yarn check:rails && yarn check:fx && yarn check:waitlist && yarn check:scenes && yarn check:email
